study.title: Enhancing sustainable Chinese cabbage production: a comparative analysis of multispectral image instance segmentation techniques
study.short_title: YOLOv8-Seg Chinese cabbage instance seg from UAV multispectral

segmentation.domain: instance segmentation of individual Chinese cabbage (Brassica rapa subsp. pekinensis) plants from UAV multispectral orthomosaics for crop counting, leaf-area monitoring and growth-stress assessment (single class)
segmentation.best_model: YOLOv8-Seg: mAP50:0.95 (M) 0.863, mAP50 (M) 0.973, mAP75 (M) 0.953 on RGB band (validation set); YOLOv8l-Seg highest scale result mAP50:0.95 (M) 0.884

dataset.name: Chinese cabbage UAV multispectral instance-segmentation dataset (Wuzhi County, Henan, China; SJFm orthomosaic)
dataset.note: DJI Phantom 4 RTK multispectral (1-inch CMOS; RGB + 4 spectral bands; 1600x1300); 6,102 images (1,017 visible + 5,089 band images) from 3 flights on 2023-10-01 at 8.5 m, 1.0 m/s, 65% side/end overlap; GSD 0.4 cm/px (0.004 m). SFM orthomosaics in RGB, NRG (NIR-R-G) and NER (NIR-RedEdge-Red) combos; SAM semi-automatic annotation + manual polygon correction -> 24,774 cabbage instances; cropped to 640x640 -> 923 images; 80% train / 20% validation split.

segmentation.backbone: YOLOv8 C2f backbone with SPPF, PAFPN neck, decoupled head (Detect + Segment), Task-Aligned Assigner; CIoU/VFL/DFL/mask-BCE loss

mIoU.ambiguity: No mean IoU reported; performance is mask/box mean Average Precision at IoU thresholds: mAP0.5, mAP0.75, mAP0.5:0.95. YOLOv8-Seg RGB: mAP0.5:0.95 (M) 0.863.

F1.ambiguity: F1 not reported; precision-recall curves summarized only via AP/mAP.

weed_F1.ambiguity: No weed class; single-class Chinese cabbage task.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Per-class F1 not reported; crop-level quality expressed via mask mAP (Table 4-5): YOLOv8-Seg RGB mAP0.5 (M) 0.973, mAP0.5:0.95 (M) 0.863. NRG 0.861 / NER 0.834 (mAP0.5:0.95 M).

edge.framework: PyTorch 1.12.0, Python 3.8, CUDA 11.3; AMD Ryzen 7 5800X 8-core 3.8 GHz, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060; AdamW (lr 0.002, momentum 0.937, wd 0.0005), 200 epochs, batch 2

fps.ambiguity: No inference speed measured in study. Table 3 reproduces standard Ultralytics COCO-val benchmarks for the YOLOv8-Seg family (CPU ONNX / A100 TensorRT) as model-reference only, not study measurements.

latency_ms.ambiguity: Not measured for the custom-trained models. Table 3 (standard COCO models, 640 px): YOLOv8s-Seg CPU ONNX 155.7 ms / A100 TensorRT 1.47 ms; YOLOv8n-Seg CPU ONNX 96.1 ms / A100 TensorRT 1.21 ms - vendor benchmark, not this study.

params_M.ambiguity: Custom-trained models on this dataset. Scales: YOLOv8n 3.2 M, m 27.2 M, l 45.9 M, x 71.7 M. (Standard Ultralytics COCO numbers in Table 3: n 3.4 M / s 11.8 M.)

gflops.ambiguity: FLOPs only in Table 3 for standard COCO models (YOLOv8n-Seg 12.6 B, s 42.6 B, m 110.2 B, l 220.5 B, x 344.1 B); no FLOPs given for the custom-trained models.

issues: Instance-segmentation study: metrics are box/mask mAP (mAP50/75/0.5:0.95) -> no RQ1 semantic metric reportable.
Metrics are from the 20% validation split (80/20; no independent test set).
Single-class dataset (24,774 cabbage instances across 923 images) - no weed/crop discrimination.
No inference timing on the custom models; Table 3 values are standard Ultralytics COCO-val benchmarks (CPU ONNX / A100 TensorRT), not study measurements; study hardware is desktop RTX 3060.
Hardware string garbled in PDF ('AMD Ryzen 75,800x' -> read as Ryzen 7 5800X); GSD 0.4 cm/px at 8.5 m; model robust down to 1.333-1.143 cm/px (YOLOv8n-Seg, Table 7).
